name: Spit-Take
text:
Frequency once per round

Requirements You're holding an item you can drink from (such as a potion or a waterskin).

---
You spit out something you drink as a comical, exaggerated bit. You Interact to drink from the item. If the item is a potion, elixir, or similar item, you can Activate it, provided it takes 1 action to do so. You then spit out a fine spray of the liquid into the face of an adjacent creature, attempting a Performance check check against that creature's Fortitude DC. Regardless of the result, that creature is temporarily immune to Spit-Take for 1 hour.

---
Critical Success The target is Dazzled for 1 minute.

Success The target is dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Critical Failure You choke a little, becoming Sickened 1.
